task_instance: Create a new Next.js-style app for Cloudflare Workers using vinext (per the skill's 'new project' workflow: install upstream vinext skills, scaffold with create-vinext-app targeting Cloudflare), then build it and run the built Worker locally with Wrangler to verify it serves both an App Router page and an API route.
tools_used: npm run start (wrangler dev against dist/server/wrangler.json)
evidence: Ran `npx skills add cloudflare/vinext` in the work dir, which cloned cloudflare/vinext and installed the upstream migrate-to-vinext skill to .agents/skills/. Since the target directory was empty (new project, not a migration), followed the skill's instruction to use create-vinext-app instead: `npx create-vinext-app@latest my-app --template cloudflare --yes` succeeded, installing vinext, @vinext/cloudflare, vite, @cloudflare/vite-plugin, and wrangler, and generating vite.config.ts, wrangler.jsonc (with compatibility_date, nodejs_compat, ASSETS/IMAGES bindings), an app/ directory (App Router page + /api/hello route), and package.json scripts (dev/build/start/deploy). Ran `npm run build` in my-app/ -> vinext build completed successfully (5-stage build: client/server refs, rsc/client/ssr environments), producing dist/client and dist/server with a Worker entry (dist/server/index.js) and wrangler.json. Ran `npm run start` (wrangler dev --config dist/server/wrangler.json --port 8787), which started a real workerd-based local Worker (Ready on http://localhost:8787). Verified with curl: GET / returned the full rendered HTML page (RSC-hydrated App Router page with Tailwind-styled content, title 'vinext on Cloudflare Workers'), and GET /api/hello returned {"message":"Hello from vinext on Cloudflare Workers"} - confirming both page rendering and API routes work end-to-end inside the Workers runtime (workerd), not just Node. All work stayed local (npm registry + GitHub clone of the public vinext repo for the skill/template; no Cloudflare account login, no `wrangler login`, and no deploy/publish step was invoked, per the sandbox's no-account/no-deployment safety rules). Project files are at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec/cloudflare__skills__nextjs-on-cloudflare/my-app (package.json, vite.config.ts, wrangler.jsonc, app/, dist/ build output).
